# Advancing the Science of <span class="accent">Public Safety.</span>


::: {.hero-intro}
The El Paso Crime Lab is an independent public research project created by <strong>Matthew Durán</strong>. The project brings together research, local data, and public information to better understand crime and public safety in El Paso and the Borderland.
:::

::: {.hero-buttons}

[Explore the Research](dwi_home.html){.hero-button .primary}

:::

:::


::: {.section-divider}
:::


::: {.about}

::: {.section-heading}

## About the Project

The El Paso Crime Lab exists to make research and local public safety information more accessible.

:::

::: {.about-grid}

::: {.about-main}

The project focuses on **understanding local public safety problems through evidence**. It brings together publicly available data, academic research, and community information to examine issues affecting El Paso and the surrounding region.

The work is independent and primarily intended as a resource for people who want to better understand crime, policing, and public safety in the Borderland.

Rather than simply presenting statistics, the goal is to provide context, explain what the data can—and cannot—tell us, and make research findings accessible to a broader audience.

:::


::: {.about-side}

::: {.about-side-label}
Public Research
:::

### Evidence for understanding local public safety.

The El Paso Crime Lab provides research, data, analysis, and public information concerning crime and public safety in the Borderland.

:::

:::

:::


::: {.focus}

::: {.section-heading}

## Areas of Focus

Research and information published through the El Paso Crime Lab generally falls into three areas.

:::


::: {.focus-grid}

::: {.focus-card}

::: {.focus-number}
01

### Research

Independent research examining crime, policing, and criminal justice issues affecting El Paso and the Borderland.

[Explore the research →](dwi_home.html){.focus-link}

:::


::: {.focus-card}

::: {.focus-number}
02
:::

### Data & Analysis

Local data, dashboards, visualizations, and analytical tools designed to make public safety information easier to explore and understand.

[Explore the data →](crash_dashboard.html){.focus-link}

:::


::: {.focus-card}

::: {.focus-number}
03
:::

### Public Information

Accessible explanations and resources that connect research and local public safety information with the people and communities they affect.

[Explore resources →](dwi_services.html){.focus-link}

:::

:::

:::


::: {.feature}

::: {.feature-label}
Featured Research
:::

## Understanding impaired driving in El Paso

One area of ongoing research examines alcohol-impaired driving using local crash data, research evidence, and community information.

Explore the data, findings, reports, and resources developed through this project.

[Explore the DWI Research Hub →](dwi_home.html){.feature-action}

:::

::: {.person-label}
Project Lead

## Matthew Durán

Matthew Durán is the researcher behind the El Paso Crime Lab. His work focuses on crime, policing, public safety, and the use of data and research to better understand local problems.
